'''Vreebo Gango''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of a band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]]. While Gango was a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], adept at flying [[Starship/Legends|starships]] along dangerous [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes, he was also very shy and he found social interactions with others difficult. At some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Gango ventured to the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on Formos, where he was tasked by his associates with making contact with another smuggler group.
